title: Deployment environments
description: GitHub deployment environments, keyed by environment name. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#environments

environment.description: Settings for a single deployment environment.

required_reviewers.description: Users or teams that must approve deployments to this environment. At most 6 entries.

id.description: Numeric id, username or team slug of the reviewer.

prevent_self_review.description: Prevent users from approving their own deployments.

wait_timer.description: Minutes to wait before allowing deployments to proceed.

deployment_branch_policy.description: Restricts which branches or tags may deploy to this environment. Exactly one of protected_branches and policies must be set.

protected_branches.description: Only allow deployments from protected branches. Mutually exclusive with policies.

policies.description: Branch or tag name patterns allowed to deploy. Mutually exclusive with protected_branches.

type.description: Whether the pattern matches branches or tags.
